newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus said in GdE cable sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus said in GdE cable sale talks.

text.p: Negotiations concerning a possible sale of Compagnie Generale de Videocommunication (CGV) are being handled by French satellite television firm Canal Plus , a source close to the talks said on Friday.
CGV is 72-percent owned by Cie Generale des Eaux and 20-percent owned by Canal Plus.
On Thursday, Generale des Eaux chairman Jean-Marie Messier said that, "if there were a sale, it would be a sale to Time Warner within the framework of a broader relationship".
"Cooperation between Time Warner and Canal Plus will be broader than cable television alone," Messier said.
He added that Generale des Eaux would in no case hold on to more than 20 percent of the cable firm.
"We believe that cable technology is not the best adapted to telecommunications services," he said.
Messier reaffirmed that negotiations should be wrapped up within four to six weeks.
